themes.label: Physical wellbeing and appearance
themes.definition: Goals about the body's health, fitness, diet, exercise, or physical appearance, beauty, and body image.

themes.label: Mental and emotional health
themes.definition: Goals about emotional or psychological wellbeing: stress reduction, meditation, mindfulness, peace of mind, or emotional balance.

themes.label: Self-worth and acceptance
themes.definition: Accepting and loving oneself as one is, self-compassion, building self-confidence, self-esteem, or positive self-worth.

themes.label: Achievement and personal growth
themes.definition: Goals about accomplishments, career or educational success, learning new skills, or striving for self-improvement.

themes.label: Social and family relationships
themes.definition: Goals tied to relationships, family, marriage, community, or how one interacts with and is viewed by other people.

themes.label: Spiritual and inner self
themes.definition: Religious, spiritual, or moral-philosophical framing: God, soul, prayer, karma, moral character, and inner spiritual growth.
